### Renovate Ignore Notification

Renovate will now ignore this PR, as it has been closed. If this was a mistake or you changed your mind, you can simply reopen or rename this PR to reactivate Renovate.

**Note**: The ignore applies only to this specific version (0.19.0), so you will still receive a PR once a newer version is released. If you wish to permanently ignore this dependency, please add it to the `ignoreDeps` array of your renovate config.
